commits.summary: The run-streams tests no longer inherit a real run's watcher, so run inside a stream they cannot ask it questions
commits.body: test_brief_run.py's fixture now drops RUN_STREAMS_*, FEATURE_LOOP_* and LOOP_CONDUCTOR from the environment. A stream of the domain-advances run ran the test of a run 'without a watcher', which built its env from os.environ: inside the stream's loop that carries RUN_STREAMS_WATCHER, so the test's made-up run-streams.sh put two merge questions (streams a and b of made-up) to the real watcher, which answered them leave (run-streams-domain-advances D001, D002). Verified: the 39 tests pass with a decoy RUN_STREAMS_WATCHER and LOOP_CONDUCTOR set, and nothing is written to the decoy.

commits.summary: The streams of domain-advances are told the leaking run-streams test is not their work
commits.body: Each stream's inbox has an item (I001, a failure) saying that test_brief_run.py's no-watcher test may hang or fail in their test runs until they have the fixture fix (smxzwqlr), and that they should not change it or block on it.
